l-e-e5-b02-10.material: ___ Jun eat breakfast this morning? Yanzu ƙarfe 8 na dare ne. Muna son zaɓar kalmar da ta dace daga Do, Does, Did don gurbin.
l-e-e5-b02-10.s.s1.r.a: Sunan abinci ba zai yanke Do, Does, Did ba.
l-e-e5-b02-10.s.s1.o.b: Cewa this morning lokaci ne da ya riga ya wuce
l-e-e5-b02-10.s.s1.o.c: Cewa eat asalin sigar aikatau ne
l-e-e5-b02-10.s.s1.r.c: Asalin sigar tana zuwa bayan kalmomin ukun, don haka ba za ta yanke zaɓin ba.
l-e-e5-b02-10.s.s1.r.d: Ga mutum ɗaya ana iya amfani da Does da Did, don haka wannan kaɗai ba zai yanke zaɓin ba.
l-e-e5-b02-10.s.s1.explain: Yanzu dare ne kuma safiyar yau ta riga ta wuce. Idan ana tambaya game da abin da ya faru a baya, a yi amfani da Did.
l-e-e5-b02-10.s.s2.model.0: Yanzu dare ne kuma safiyar yau ta wuce, saboda haka ana buƙatar Did. Ko lokacin ya riga ya wuce shi ne ma’auni.
l-e-e5-b02-10.s.s2.model.1: Kasancewar mutum ɗaya ya dace da Does da Did, saboda haka ba zai yanke zaɓin ba; amma wucewar lokaci tana yanke Did, wannan bayanin ake buƙata.

l-e-e5-b03-08.goal: Don gano yadda ake nemo babbar jimla a cikin rubutu, ka yanke shawarar wane ma'auni (bayani) ake bukata da gaske, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.

l-e-e5-b03-08.s.s1.r.c: Jimlar farko na iya zama babbar jimla, amma matsayi kaɗai ba ya yanke hakan.

l-e-e5-b03-08.s.s1.explain: Sauran jimlolin suna bayyana “Sleep is important.” Jimlar da sauran suke bayyanawa ita ce babbar jimla.

l-e-e5-b07-07.title: Rubutun bas: amsar da ta cika kowane sharadi
l-e-e5-b07-07.goal: A cikin amsa mai kalmomi 7 ko ƙasa da haka da ke ba da dalilin da aka samu a rubutun, ka yi la'akari da sharuɗɗan da suka yi karo da juna, ka zaɓi mafi kyawun daidaitawa, sannan ka bayyana dalili.
l-e-e5-b07-07.material: Rubutu: “Bas ɗin ya lalace, saboda haka ajin ya jira minti 20 domin wani sabo.” Tambaya: Me ya sa ajin ya jira? Amsar dole ta kasance da kalmomi 7 ko ƙasa da haka, ta ba da dalilin da ke cikin rubutun, kuma ta zama cikakkiyar jimla.
l-e-e5-b07-07.s.s1.r.b: Dalilin ruwan sama ba ya cikin rubutun.
l-e-e5-b07-07.s.s1.r.c: Dalilin daidai ne, amma ba cikakkiyar jimla ba ce.
l-e-e5-b07-07.s.s1.r.d: Tana faɗin lokaci kawai, ta bar dalilin.
l-e-e5-b07-07.s.s1.explain: Amsa ta farko kaɗai ce cikakkiyar jimla mai kalmomi 7 da ta ƙunshi dalilin da ke cikin rubutun (bas ɗin ya lalace).
l-e-e5-b07-07.s.s2.model.0: Wannan amsa ce mafi dacewa domin ta ƙunshi dalilin daga rubutun, bas ɗin ya lalace, kuma cikakkiyar jimla ce mai kalmomi 7.
l-e-e5-b07-07.s.s2.model.1: Sauran amsoshin sun ba da dalilin da ba ya cikin rubutun, ba jimloli ba ne, ko ba su da dalili, don haka wannan amsa ta cika duk sharuɗɗan.
